title: Check the brief together
instruction: Watch two teammates discuss a design. Explain the disagreement, then suggest how to check an idea for the Login screen

video.title: Agreeing and disagreeing — British Council | English

items.prompt: What does Paul say the client wants?
items.hint: Listen for the two words describing the design
items.answer: The client wants a clean, minimal design

items.prompt: Why is Emir unsure about Paul’s design?
items.answer: Emir thinks Paul’s design is too simple

items.prompt: Why does Paul think Emir’s examples do not fit the brief?
items.hint: Think about how busy the examples look
items.answer: Paul thinks the examples have too much going on for the client’s brief

items.prompt: How would you check a teammate’s idea before changing the Login screen?
items.hint: Refer to the brief and ask one clear question
items.answer: Example: Could we check the brief together? Which change would help customers sign in?
